events.title: Neon City Update
events.summary: Hyper Vyper's biggest update yet lands for Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26. The demo leaves the test arena and moves into a full city: 900 by 900 meters of streets, rooftops, rail viaducts and surf lines, built for the way we move. Slide, jump, wall jump, slide again, and fight across multiple levels of a city that goes up as much as it goes out.The look was rebuilt with it. events.title: v 0.19 Hotfixes
events.summary: A few different changes have gone live for the demo since it released, these have all been apart of the same version. Capturing everything that's changed here, next patch will be a new major version with bigger changes. - Fixed several crashes, most of which were caused by world-transition- Fixed a bug causing level ups to be applied n times, with n being the number of runs within your play session. ie; on your 3rd run, level ups were applied 3 times.- Reduced higher tier enemy hp between 10-20%
